lessons_used: Reordering the onboarding flow, adding preset fallback choices, and adding background render status indicators were helpful.
Interactive screen redesigns and desktop hint notifications hurt performance.
Copy changes, guidelines, layout tweaks, hints, and incentives showed no clear effect.
Predictions were underestimated for preset fallback choices and background status indicators.
Predictions were consistently too high for redesigns, hint notifications, copy changes, guidelines, layout tweaks, and new flow additions.

candidates.title: Move Sign-In After Photo Upload
candidates.change: Reorder the onboarding sequence to place sign-in directly after photo upload and before adoption certificate creation.
candidates.why: Sign-in has an 81.1% completion rate with low median time (3s), but asking users to sign in before choosing their pet disrupts pet selection momentum.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in after photo upload is explicitly permitted under rule 4 and retains all required steps.

candidates.score_note: Reordering sign-in has strong historical lift (+8.8%) and addresses early momentum drop.

candidates.title: Preset Photo Selector Component Redesign
candidates.change: Replace the photo upload section with interactive sample photo choice cards alongside the upload option.
candidates.why: Support receives emails about custom pet generation failing or looking wrong, and adoption step drop-off is high (65.6%). Preset fallbacks tested well previously.

photo_upload.text: Select a sample portrait or upload your own photo

guard.reason: 'upload_photos.replace.photo_upload[0]': a choice_cards cannot do the photo_upload job (use ['button', 'checklist', 'image', 'photo_picker', 'text'])

candidates.title: Dedicated Render Preparation Screen
candidates.change: Insert a dedicated pre-render status screen before the waiting screen showing asset preparation steps.
candidates.why: The home stage waiting process has a long mean duration (2336s) and support emails report pets failing to display on desktop.

new_render_prep.headline: Preparing Desktop Pet Assets
new_render_prep.body: Verifying render engine readiness and unpacking companion files.

guard.reason: Adding a new pre-render preparation screen inside onboarding is allowed under rule 4 and keeps all required steps.

candidates.score_note: Adding new screens and redesigns consistently hurt conversion despite high support callout.

candidates.title: Prioritize Path Choice Over Intro Story
candidates.change: Swap the initial story screen and path selection screen so users immediately pick their onboarding route.
candidates.why: Choose path takes a mean time of 514s despite a fast median of 8s, showing users get delayed in intro story screens.

guard.reason: existing screens must keep their order; only sign_in may move

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Background Status Toggle
candidates.change: Enable background execution status indicators and step counters on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: Background render indicators previously helped retention during generation delays.

guard.reason: Adding status indicators and step counters to the waiting screen is permitted inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Config toggle for background status indicator aligns with proven historical gains (+4.8%).

candidates.title: Home Intro Quick Control Checklist Redesign
candidates.change: Replace the standard welcome area on home intro with an explicit desktop control checklist component.
candidates.why: Support receives multiple inquiries after onboarding regarding how to control, hide, or talk to their desktop pet, and finish conversion drops to 64.8%.

home_welcome.text: 1. Left-click to pet. 2. Drag to reposition on screen. 3. Right-click for options menu.

guard.reason: replacement for 'home_intro.home_welcome' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['animation', 'image', 'mascot', 'text'] with real words

candidates.title: Account Selection Choice Cards Redesign
candidates.change: Replace standard sign-in options with distinct account choice cards separating new adoption from returning account login.
candidates.why: The top support theme is existing users losing or resetting pets after signing in again (8 emails).

sign_in_options.text: Choose 'Returning Owner' to restore existing pets or 'New Owner' to create a new companion.

guard.reason: replacement for 'sign_in.sign_in_options' does not do the job (a sign-in button that says so): needs 1 of ['button', 'choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Pick Friend Visual Choice Cards Redesign
candidates.change: Replace default friend choices with high-visibility playful choice cards on the pick_friend screen.
candidates.why: Adoption step has the lowest conversion rate among early steps (65.6%) with a high median time (89s).

guard.reason: replacement for 'pick_friend.pet_choices' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Mascot Guided Intro Story Redesign
candidates.change: Replace the opening story intro block with a mascot component to welcome new users.
candidates.why: The story screen is the first touchpoint in choose_path where long tail drop-offs occur (mean time 514s).

intro_story.text: Hi! Pick how you would like to create your desktop companion today.

guard.reason: replacement for 'story.intro_story' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['animation', 'image', 'mascot', 'video'] with an asset:story/ asset

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Status Estimate Badge
candidates.change: Add an active generation status badge component to the waiting screen.
candidates.why: Home stage has a median time of 201s and mean of 2336s; clear waiting indicators prevent app abandonment.

components.text: Pet render engine initializing in background

guard.reason: Adding a status badge and time estimate for a real pet generation wait on the waiting screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Status estimate component helps reduce wait dropoff but requires UI changes.

lessons_next: Preset fallback choices, background render status indicators, and certain onboarding flow reorders were helpful.
Interactive screen redesigns, desktop hint notifications, and moving sign-in after photo upload hurt performance.
Copy changes, guidelines, layout tweaks, hints, incentives, and other flow additions showed no clear effect.
Predictions were underestimated for preset fallback choices and background render status indicators.
Predictions were consistently too high for redesigns, notifications, copy changes, guidelines, layout tweaks, incentives, and new flow additions.
